Studies
Choose from a range of degree programmes covering over 180 subject areas. In the heart of one of the most liveable cities in the world.
Research
Excellent research with international visibility in an inspiring academic environment.
Career
Various career opportunities in academic research, teaching and administration at the largest university in Austria.
Innovation
From research to practice – innovation of social relevance and from a global perspective.
A place where brilliant minds change the world.
The University of Vienna is known for excellent research, a wide variety of degree programmes and an international academic environment. With around one third of its students coming from abroad and partnerships with over 400 universities worldwide, the University of Vienna is a hub for academic research and cultural exchange.
Whether through a bachelor's programme, master's programme, teacher education programme, continuing education or a career in research – we offer space for personal, professional and academic development. In the heart of one of the most liveable cities in the world, tradition and innovation are fused with each other at a place of learning, teaching, thinking and shaping.
What unites us at the University of Vienna

What are the big questions of our time?
Semester question: The topics range from climate and democracy, through artificial intelligence and data protection, as well as health and sustainability.
Studying at the University of Vienna
Welcome to a place where the future is reimagined every day. Our teachers support students with expertise and commitment, promote critical thinking and open up new perspectives in academic studies and continuing education. Find the right learning environment and grow through mutual support, peer activities and mentoring.
Ready to shape the world? Welcome to the University of Vienna!
©
Ian Ehm
Innovation and transfer
Innovation is our motor, curiosity our principle. We are a vibrant community that provides space for new ideas. Ranked among the top 4 per cent of all universities worldwide, the University of Vienna is located in one of Europe’s largest academic locations. For over 650 years the University of Vienna has represented education, research, innovation and knowledge transfer. Here, people from a broad spectrum of disciplines come together to carry out research at the highest level and develop solutions for tomorrow’s challenges.

Strategic priorities
Our researchers work with passion and dedication to find solutions for tomorrow’s world. At the heart of everything we do is always the vision of developing ideas that drive society forward. And our results generate attention – in the media, in politics and in society as a whole. We place particular focus on culture, education and democracy, digitalisation as well as global health, the climate, sustainability and systems of life as well as quantum systems and materials for the future.
